Previous Meetings

These two teams have met five times, winning two games each while one ended in a draw. Four of them were friendlies and they are also level on five goals apiece overall.

Match Stats

  • Unites States beat Portugal 3-2 in the only competitive meeting between the two sides, the result helping them advance to the last 16 in the 2002 World Cup at the expense of the Portuguese.

  • United States coach Juergen Klinsmann was in charge of his native Germany when they beat Portugal 3-1 in the 2006 tournament's third-place match.

  • Portugal suffered their worst World Cup defeat in the previous 4-0 drubbing by Germany.

  • Portugal have twice reached the semi-finals in their five previous World Cup appearances.

  • The USA have only kept two clean sheets in their last 24 games at the World Cup.

Team News

  • Portuguese winger Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly told the Portuguese medical team: "I'm the one that says whether I'm playing or not.”

  • Portugal will definitely be missing other players, the injured Fabio Coentrao and Hugo Almeida, who limped out of the Germany game, and they will also be without the suspended Pepe.
